title: [PM-42854] bugs with policies drawers
body: ## 🎟️ Tracking https://bitwarden.atlassian.net/browse/PM-42854 ## 📔 Objective Fixes up copies on Policies Drawers for VFO 1 Terminology ## 📸 Screenshots

reviews.body: Confirmed that since @mzieniukbw 's last approving review no relevant KM code changed, so re-approving.

inline.body:
♻️ **DEBT**: These VFO1 variants now duplicate their legacy strings verbatim — consider reusing the legacy keys instead.

<details>
<summary>Details and fix</summary>

`automaticAppLoginWithSSODescListVfo1` is now byte-identical to `automaticAppLoginWithSSODescV2`, and `freeFamiliesSponsorshipDescVfo1` (line 14918) is identical to `freeFamiliesSponsorshipPolicyDescV2`. Duplicated `en` strings are translated twice in Crowdin and can silently drift apart on a later copy edit.

When the VFO1 copy matches the legacy copy, existing definitions point the VFO1 property at the legacy key rather than duplicating the message — e.g. `uri-match-default.component.ts` uses `drawerDescriptionVfo1 = "uriMatchDetectionPolicyDescV2"` and `two-factor-authentication.component.ts` uses `drawerDescriptionVfo1 = "twoStepLoginPolicyDescV2"`.

Here the simplest equivalent is to drop `descriptionVfo1`/`drawerDescriptionVfo1` from `AutomaticAppLoginPolicy`, drop `descriptionVfo1` from `FreeFamiliesSponsorshipPolicy`, and delete the two now-redundant keys — the `?? policy.description` fallback in `policyDescriptionKeys`/`policyDrawerDescriptionKeys` renders the same copy.
</details>

❓ **QUESTION**: Dropping `descriptionVfo1` reverts the VFO1 list copy and orphans `freeFamiliesSponsorshipDescVfo1` — intended?

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

The last commit removes `descriptionVfo1 = "freeFamiliesSponsorshipDescVfo1"`, which exists on `main`. Two effects:

1. `policyDescriptionKeys` falls back to `description`, so with the VFO1 flag on the policies list now shows "Do not allow members to redeem a Families plan sponsored by your organization." instead of "Remove the option for members to redeem a free Families plan." The row title still uses `nameVfo1`, so title and description end up on different copy tracks.
2. `freeFamiliesSponsorshipDescVfo1` is left in `apps/web/src/locales/en/messages.json:14924` with no remaining code reference — Crowdin will keep translating a dead string. Elsewhere in this PR the reference and the key were removed together (`automaticAppLoginWithSSODescListVfo1`).

If the sibling terminology PR owns this policy's copy, ignore this. Otherwise either restore the property or delete the now-unused `en` key.
</details>

comments.body:
## 🤖 Bitwarden Claude Code Review

**Overall Assessment:** APPROVE

Reviewed the VFO1 terminology copy fixes for the policy drawers: the new `hideWarningVfo1` flag on `BasePolicyEditDefinition` and its use in `PolicyEditDrawerComponent.warningKeys`, the drawer description repointing for Require SSO and Automatic app login, the Session timeout prerequisite callout moving from the component template into `prerequisiteKey`/`prerequisiteKeyVfo1`, and the removal of `requireSsoPolicyDescV2Vfo1` from the `en` locale. Verified every referenced key exists in `apps/web/src/locales/en/messages.json` and that the removed key has no remaining code references — the leftovers in non-`en` locales are Crowdin-managed and correctly untouched. Confirmed `SessionTimeoutPolicy` registers no custom `editDialogComponent`, so it always opens through `PolicyEditDrawerComponent`, which renders the prerequisite callout above the policy form in the same `@else` branch the old template callout occupied; `CalloutComponent` is no longer referenced by `session-timeout.component.html` and no spec asserts on it. Hiding the Single organization member warning under VFO1 does not drop the substantive detail, since the drawer description for that policy (`singleOrgPolicyDescV2Vfo1`) already states that non-compliant members have access revoked and that owners/admins are exempt, and `MultiStepPolicyEditDialogComponent` never renders `warningKey`, so the new flag has no unhandled second render path.

<details>
<summary>Code Review Details</summary>

No new findings.

`Vfo1TerminologyService` was already reachable from this component through the impure `Vfo1I18nPipe`, so injecting it directly adds no new DI requirement for existing tests or stories, and the signal read inside the `warningKeys` getter is evaluated in the template's reactive context, so the callout still resolves correctly once the feature flag emits.

The two existing threads on this PR are resolved and outdated — the `free-families-sponsorship.component.ts` and `automaticAppLoginWithSSODescListVfo1` concerns they raised are no longer part of this diff.

</details>
